Module wpilib.epilogue

module wpilib.epilogue
Provides APIs for telemetry and data logging, used by code generated based on the presence of the Logged annotation on classes, fields, and methods. The epilogue annotation processor - in a separate module - performs the actual code generation, including generating the org.wpilib.epilogue.generated.Epilogue entrypoint.
